# AI Data Index

This website exposes a machine-readable AI Data Index. AI Data Index is a practical open convention, not an official universal web standard.

Main manifest:
https://www.example.com/json/index.json

API endpoint:
https://www.example.com/json/index.php

AI sitemap:
https://www.example.com/json/sitemap-ai.xml

Core structured resources:
https://www.example.com/json/pages/home.json
https://www.example.com/json/pages/about.json
https://www.example.com/json/services/index.json
https://www.example.com/json/pages/contacts.json

Recommended interpretation:
- Files with `"format": "ai-json"` are manifests, lists, indexes, navigation, or relationship files.
- Files with `"format": "json-ld"` are final semantic entities using Schema.org.
